m.s: Heat the oven to 150°C fan-forced and line the base of a 22cm springform tin with baking paper. Blitz {sweetbiscuits} into fine crumbs, or bash them in a zip-lock bag with a rolling pin. Mix with melted {butter}, press firmly into the base of the tin, and chill while you make the filling.
Take {creamcheese} out of the fridge an hour before so it's soft. Beat it with {castersugar} until smooth, about 2 minutes. Add {eggs} one at a time, beating on low just until each one disappears.
Beat in {sourcream}, the finely grated zest and juice of {lemon}, {vanilla} and {flour} until smooth. Keep the mixer on low the whole time: too much air makes it crack.
Pour the filling over the base and smooth the top. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes, until the edges are set but the middle still has a gentle wobble.
Turn the oven off, prop the door open a little and leave the cheesecake inside for 1 hour. Cooling it slowly stops the top cracking.
Cover and chill for at least 4 hours, or overnight. Run a hot knife round the edge before you open the tin, and cut into 12 slices with the knife dipped in hot water.

g: Use GF plain sweet biscuits for the base and GF plain flour in the filling. GF biscuits are a little drier, so add an extra tablespoon of melted butter to the crumbs.
k: Keeps covered in the fridge for 5 days. Slices freeze well wrapped in cling wrap for up to 2 months.
